items.title: I posted to HN, and then my website was flooded with AI bot traffic
items.summary: For the past few years, I've been working on sprinklz.io , a customizable feed reader that can, among other things, deprioritize certain topics from your news feed.
items.titleZh: 我在 HN 发帖后，网站涌入了大量 AI 机器人流量
items.summaryZh: 过去几年，我一直在开发 sprinklz.io——一款可自定义的订阅源阅读器，其中一项功能是降低某些主题在新闻订阅源中的优先级。

items.title: Show HN: Pulse Local, a Mac budgeting app whose AI models run on your machine
items.summary: A budgeting app with AI on your own machine. Your ledger and your questions both stay on disk. The models download once, then nothing about you leaves.
items.titleZh: Show HN：Pulse Local，一款 AI 模型在本机运行的 Mac 记账应用
items.summaryZh: 一款让 AI 在你自己的设备上运行的记账应用。账本和你的提问都保留在本地磁盘。模型只需下载一次，此后你的任何信息都不会离开设备。

items.title: I built a tool to track what AI leaders say and how their views change on video
items.summary: Interviews, podcasts and talks from Sam Altman, Dario Amodei, Jensen Huang and other AI leaders, found every day, with AI summaries of what they said and checked quotes.
items.titleZh: 我开发了一款工具，可追踪 AI 领袖在视频中的言论及其观点变化
items.summaryZh: 每天搜集 Sam Altman、Dario Amodei、Jensen Huang 等 AI 领袖的访谈、播客和演讲，并用 AI 总结其言论、核对引述内容。

items.title: Apple HomeView
items.summary: Apple HomeView is a smart display with Siri AI, Liquid Retina display, high-fidelity audio, FaceTime, smart home controls, built-in privacy, and more.
items.summaryZh: Apple HomeView 是一款智能显示屏，配备 Siri AI、Liquid Retina 显示屏、高保真音频、FaceTime、智能家居控制功能和内置隐私保护等。

items.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
items.summary: As our merges per day grew more than tenfold, source control became our biggest development bottleneck. Here, we share how we migrated to an in-house version control system in five months.
items.titleZh: Anthropic 如何重新设计源代码管理
items.summaryZh: 随着每日合并次数增长到原来的十倍以上，源代码管理成了我们最大的开发瓶颈。本文分享我们如何在五个月内迁移到自研版本控制系统。

items.title: New Apple TV 4K
items.summary: Apple today announced the next generation of Apple TV 4K, delivering its most immersive home theater experience yet.
items.summaryZh: Apple 今日发布新一代 Apple TV 4K，带来迄今沉浸感最强的家庭影院体验。

items.title: Science Corporation implants its vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient
items.summary: Max Hodak, the former president and co-founder of Neuralink, detailed on stage at TechCrunch Disrupt how his company's work with PRIMA is part of its path toward a novel brain-computer interface (BCI).
items.titleZh: Science Corporation 为首位 Stargardt 病患者植入视力恢复芯片
items.summaryZh: Neuralink 前总裁兼联合创始人 Max Hodak 在 TechCrunch Disrupt 现场详述了其公司与 PRIMA 的合作，以及这项工作如何推动一种新型脑机接口（BCI）的研发。

items.title: Cerebras CEO says we’re nearing a future where everyone has a personal AI assistant at home
items.summary: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman predicts a future where personal AI assistants become as commonplace as household appliances, running partly on local devices and partly in the cloud.
items.titleZh: Cerebras 首席执行官称，人人都将在家拥有 AI 助手的时代即将到来
items.summaryZh: Cerebras 首席执行官 Andrew Feldman 预测，个人 AI 助手将像家用电器一样普及，部分运行在本地设备上，部分运行在云端。

items.title: Industrial Next wants factory robots to switch tasks in minutes, not weeks
items.summary: Industrial Next helps manufacturers automate complex, delicate tasks that have traditionally required human labor.
items.titleZh: Industrial Next 希望工厂机器人切换任务只需几分钟，而非几周
items.summaryZh: Industrial Next 帮助制造商将复杂、精细且传统上需要人工完成的任务自动化。

items.title: Cerebras CEO pushes back on AI doomsday warnings
items.summary: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman has a message for AI leaders spreading doomsday warnings: Maybe stop talking? At TechCrunch Disrupt, he argued that the industry's focus on AI's risks is drowning out its potential benefits.
items.titleZh: Cerebras 首席执行官反驳 AI 末日警告
items.summaryZh: Cerebras 首席执行官 Andrew Feldman 向散布 AI 末日警告的业界领袖喊话：或许该少谈一些？他在 TechCrunch Disrupt 上表示，业界过度聚焦 AI 风险，掩盖了其潜在益处。

items.title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
items.summary: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the case.
items.titleZh: 法官下令 OpenAI 在 Apple 商业机密案中提交招聘记录
items.summaryZh: 联邦法官裁定，Apple 可以查阅 OpenAI 涉及前 Apple 员工的面试材料，以及案件关键人物的私人消息和证词。

items.title: Justice Department says North Koreans have infiltrated dozens of U.S. companies
items.summary: U.S. authorities warn that sanctioned hackers are increasingly targeting Americans to act as facilitators between breached U.S. companies and Pyongyang.
items.titleZh: 美国司法部称朝鲜人已渗透数十家美国公司
items.summaryZh: 美国当局警告，受制裁的黑客正日益将美国人作为中间人，协助遭入侵的美国公司与平壤方面联络。

items.title: Helix Carbon says it can make iron cheaper by recycling blast furnace pollution
items.summary: The steel industry is a big polluter, but Helix Carbon can upcycle pollution from blast furnaces to drive down emissions and improve margins.
items.titleZh: Helix Carbon 称可通过回收高炉污染物降低炼铁成本
items.summaryZh: 钢铁行业是主要污染源，但 Helix Carbon 可将高炉污染物升级再利用，从而减少排放并提高利润率。

items.title: FBI arrests OpenAI employee accused of planting hidden recording device in conference room
items.summary: It's not clear exactly for what purpose the recording device was used, but FBI director Kash Patel said the scheme was to "capture sensitive communications about the company’s super intelligence technology."
items.titleZh: FBI 逮捕一名被指在会议室放置隐藏录音设备的 OpenAI 员工
items.summaryZh: 目前尚不清楚该录音设备的具体用途，但 FBI 局长 Kash Patel 表示，此举意在“窃取有关该公司超级智能技术的敏感通信内容”。
